history.body: Hi, I saw your Pearl Residences ad. I’m considering a longer-term property hold — what supports the location’s long-term appeal?

For a longer-term hold, Pearl Residences is in established Seberang Jaya, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and Butterworth’s mainland urban network. Would you like to come and see the location for yourself? Would weekdays or weekends suit you better?

That established setting sounds relevant to what I’m looking for, so I’d be open to a weekend viewing. Before we set a time, could you share the tenure and roughly how far the project is from Sunway Carnival Mall and the main Butterworth links?

I don’t want to guess on the tenure or distances, so I’ll have the team confirm those for you. Since you’re open to a weekend viewing, they can also check the available slots and follow up before setting a time.
